notes: Promoted 2026-10-21 by the signal-engine autopilot (signal engine v1, docs/research_lab/signal_engine/DESIGN_V1.md section 9). Measured on the host 2026-10-20 23:26-23:45Z in a read-only dry run (/tmp/sigeng, engine root outside ~/arepo, deleted afterwards). Resolution fetch: 2 requests x 50 ids in 2.3 s, 100/100 parsed resolved (C1 rules), 160 MB RSS; 53,152 candidates / 19,128 due after 2.3 days of captures, so the first days work through a backlog (~400 requests). No other job's spec changed. 2026-10-22 (signal-engine autopilot): attempts 1-3 died with MemoryError at the 2.0 GB address-space cap at ~460 MB RSS (virtual memory, not RAM). Read-only host profile of score_prospective alone: 1,983 MB virtual / 516 MB RSS; the resolve step before it pushes the run over 2.0 GB. as_cap_mb 2000 -> 3000; mem_mb unchanged.
